$comment: Configuration for scripts/sandboxes.mjs — the generator that turns the
workspace examples into standalone StackBlitz projects.
Adding a sandbox means adding an entry here and nothing else. The examples
stay the single source of truth; everything under outDir is generated and
must never be hand-edited (`pnpm sandboxes:check` fails the build if it is).
Playwright is stripped from every sandbox: it cannot run in a WebContainer,
and shipping a `test` script that always fails is worse than shipping none.
$stripDependencies: Removed from every generated sandbox — CI tooling that a browser container cannot run.
$stripScripts: Scripts removed because their tooling was stripped above.
$stripPaths: Never copied. Build output, editor state, and CI-only fixtures.

sandboxes.name: next-app
sandboxes.title: Next.js — App Router
sandboxes.blurb: Provider in a client component, anchors in server components, route-aware steps.
sandboxes.$note: Next boots slowly in a WebContainer — roughly 30s. Worth it: it is the framework most people arrive with.

sandboxes.name: react-vite
sandboxes.title: React — Vite + react-router
